# Inquiry Publishing Stack — PPF entrypoint

Current component: Personal Publishing Framework (PPF)
Role: source-centered publishing lifecycle, releases, archives, and Continuous Web.

Human conceptual entrypoint:
https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/
Human Guide:
https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/AI-Assisted-Human-Inquiry-and-Creation-Protocol/blob/main/docs/HUMAN_GUIDE.md

Machine/configuration entrypoint:
https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/agent/
Machine descriptor:
https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/agent/entry.json
Machine-readable ecosystem:
https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/ecosystem.yaml

Canonical ecosystem:
https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/ECOSYSTEM.md
Machine-readable ecosystem:
https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/ecosystem.yaml
Agent retrieval contract:
https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/AGENT_RETRIEVAL_CONTRACT.md

Public homepages:
- AHICP: https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/
- PPF: https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/ppf/
- Vault Interface: https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/vault-interface/
- Starter: https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/starter/

For full-stack projects, default to full AHICP + full PPF + Vault Interface. For any original or unpublished PPF project, canonical source is private by default and Continuous Web is restricted/authenticated until explicit public-release authorization. Public links do not authorize private-state access.

Cloudflare entrypoint:
https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Personal-Publishing-Framework/blob/main/docs/CONTINUOUS_WEB_CLOUDFLARE.md

GitHub–Cloudflare infrastructure integration standard:
https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Personal-Publishing-Framework/blob/main/docs/GITHUB_CLOUDFLARE_INTEGRATION.md

Public delivery migration:
For new deployments, Cloudflare Workers Static Assets + Workers Builds is preferred. Cloudflare Pages remains supported for existing projects and is not migrated automatically. The four framework sections now use the verified canonical Worker at https://inquirystack.philohub.workers.dev/; legacy GitHub Pages URLs remain available.
Migration guide: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_DELIVERY_MIGRATION.md
Migration state: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/templates/cloudflare-public-delivery.yaml

Commit-driven unified publication (registered public outputs only):
Default-branch pushes notify Starter through the account-installed GitHub App. Source-lock updates use App-created pull requests, required CI checks, and normal branch protection before native Cloudflare deployment. The App private key stays in Cloudflare. No scheduled polling or upstream personal-token secret is required. New publications require explicit registration and installation approval.
English contract: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/GITHUB_APP_PUBLICATION.md
Chinese contract: https://github.com/ChongLiuPhil/Inquiry-Publishing-Project-Starter/blob/main/docs/GITHUB_APP_PUBLICATION.zh-CN.md
